notif.title: Notifications
notif.none: No notifications yet. Requests, invitations, comments and changes in your spaces will appear here.

share.nameMissing: Please enter a name for the new space.
share.subtitle: You choose exactly what is shared. Friendship alone gives nobody access.
share.notSyncedText: There are local changes the server does not know yet. Only the synced state can be shared – please go online and wait a moment.
share.ownerHint: You become the owner. You then invite members from within the space – confirmed friends only.
share.moveWarnText: The entries (including plants, entries and photos) then belong to the space and disappear from your private data. The space owner manages them; members see them according to their role. If you leave the space or it is deleted, you lose access – export anything you want to keep beforehand. The operation completes fully or not at all (no partial transfer).
share.notMovable: Only grows, journal entries and lab reports can be moved – other entries are always shared as a copy.
share.understood: I understand that the entries will then belong to the space and will no longer be in my private data.
share.pickerSubtitle: Only the selected entries are shared – nothing else.
share.photosHint: Related photos are re-encrypted with the space key.
share.tasksHint: The grow's reminders become shared tasks.
share.quantitiesHint: Off by default: stock and quantity history stay private.
share.costsHint: Off by default: prices, purchase date and warranty stay private.
share.title: Share {what}
share.copyA: An independent copy is created. Your original stays private and unchanged; later private changes are
share.copyB: transferred. The copy is marked as “Shared copy” in the space.

n.friendRequest: {who} wants to be friends with you.
n.invite: {who} invites you to a shared space.
n.removed: {who} removed you from a shared space. Your access has ended.
n.transferOffered: {who} wants to transfer ownership{inSpace} to you.
n.deleted: {who} deleted a shared space you were a member of.

a.shared: {actor} shared {items} private entries as a copy{target}.
a.access: {actor} set the access level of {target} to “{access}”.

origin.copyHint: Shared copy – independent of the private original; later private changes are not transferred.
origin.movedHint: Moved to the space – belongs to the space.

cm.removeMine: Your comment will be removed for all members.
cm.removeOwner: As the owner, you remove the comment for everyone.
cm.emptyCan: No comments yet – write the first one.
cm.hint: Comments are visible to all members who may see this entry. Stored encrypted with the space key.
cm.viewer: With the “View” role you can read comments but not write them.

pc.a1: You no longer see each other's shared profile details, and open invitations between you end. Shared spaces stay unchanged. The person is not notified.
pc.a2: The friendship ends, open requests and invitations are ended, the person is removed from your own spaces and can no longer send you anything. In spaces owned by others you both remain members – you can leave them.
pc.a3: Your access ends immediately. Your contributions and comments remain in the space because they are used jointly there.
pc.a4: Access ends at the next request – offline devices do not get it back either; space content cached there is discarded.
pc.a5: It disappears for all members along with its sub-content. Shared copies are independent: your private original remains.
pc.a6: Spaces where you are the only member are deleted as well. If you own spaces with other members, you must transfer or explicitly delete them first – other people's data is never silently deleted. Your comments remain as “Deleted account”.
pc.a7: The recipient must accept. They then manage members and rights, and you become “Edit”. The files count towards their storage quota.
pc.a8: Exports, downloads and screenshots are on that person's device and cannot be revoked remotely. Only share with people you trust.
pc.title: Collaboration & sharing
pc.subtitle: Who can see what – with immediate revocation. Nothing is shared automatically.
pc.needServer: This overview needs a connection to the server.
pc.noLogin: Nobody sees your login name. There is no public profile and no directory.
pc.unfriendMsg: You no longer see each other's shared profile details; open invitations between you are withdrawn. Shared spaces stay unchanged.
pc.blockMsg: The friendship ends, no more new requests, invitations or notifications; removal from your own spaces.
pc.noOwn: You do not own any shared spaces.
pc.noMemberships: You are not a member of anyone else's space.
pc.leaveMsg: You lose access immediately. Your contributions remain in the space (they belong to the space). Export anything you want to keep first.
pc.encryption: Shared content is encrypted on the server with its own space key (AES-256-GCM) – separate from your account key. No end-to-end encryption: the server operator could technically decrypt.

th.p1d: Nothing is shared automatically. You choose every entry individually and see a preview first.
th.p2d: Content is encrypted on the server with a separate space key – separate from your account. Not end-to-end encryption.
th.p3d: No directory, no public profiles or links. You find friends via handle, social ID or invitation code.
th.title: Together
th.subtitle: Private spaces for trusted friends – only within this TERPGRID instance, nothing is public.
th.noneOwn: No space of your own yet
th.noneOwnText: Create a space, share a specific grow, strains or lab reports and invite friends with a suitable role.
th.sharedNone: Nothing yet. When friends invite you to a space, the invitation appears above – you decide whether to join.
th.newSub: You become the owner. The space gets its own key.
th.name: Name

fr.u1: You no longer see each other's shared profile details.
fr.u2: Open invitations between you are withdrawn.
fr.u3: Shared spaces stay unchanged – memberships do not end automatically.
fr.u4: The other person is not notified.
fr.b1: The friendship ends; open requests and invitations between you are ended.
fr.b2: This person can no longer send you requests, invitations or notifications and does not see your profile.
fr.b3: They are removed from your own spaces. In spaces owned by others you both remain members – you can leave them.
fr.b4: Nobody can remotely delete copies that have already been downloaded.
fr.title: Friends
fr.subtitle: Private friendships – no directory, no public search.
fr.exact: Exact values only. For privacy reasons TERPGRID does not say whether a matching account exists – declined requests also stay “pending” for you until they expire after 30 days.
fr.codeHint: A link for exactly one person, valid for 7 days, revocable at any time. Whoever opens and accepts it immediately becomes your friend.
fr.declinedSilent: Declined – the person is not informed
fr.noFriendsText: Send a request to an exact handle or social ID – or share an invitation link with someone you trust.
fr.unblocked: Unblocked – this does not create a friendship
fr.linkSub: Shown only now – only a check value is stored.
fr.nickEnc: Encrypted with your account key – the other person never sees it.
fr.hideProfile: Hide my profile from this person
fr.hideHint: They then only see your handle or social ID and your display name, no other profile details.
fr.shareHint: Only share the link with the person you want to invite (e.g. in person or via an encrypted messenger).

pf.badType: Please choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
pf.regenMsg: Your previous social ID will then no longer work for new requests. Existing friendships remain.
pf.title: My profile
pf.subtitle: Private by default. You decide per field what confirmed friends see – nothing is public.
pf.imgHint: Resized in the browser to at most 256 px. Metadata (e.g. GPS) is removed.
pf.bioPh: A few words about you and your growing
pf.strainPh: Type a strain and press Enter
pf.handleHint: 3–24 characters (a–z, 0–9, dot, underscore). Must not be your login name – that stays private.
pf.allowHint: Off: friends only via your invitation links.
pf.membersSee: Members of shared spaces you are not friends with only see your display name and handle or social ID. Nobody sees your login name.

pp.unavailableText: This profile is not (or no longer) shared with you.
pp.noMore: No further profile details shared with you.
pp.onlyShared: You only see details this person has explicitly shared with friends. Friendship grants no access to private data.
pp.invalidText: This invitation is invalid, expired or has already been used. Ask for a new link.
pp.invites: invites you to be friends on this TERPGRID instance.
pp.f1: Friends only see profile details you share.
pp.f2: No access to private data – only what you deliberately put into a space is shared.
pp.f3: Can be ended or blocked at any time.
pp.notifsSub: In the app only – no third-party push services, no emails. Previews contain no content.
pp.alwaysOn: Notices about rights and access always stay on for security reasons.
pp.retention: Notifications are only shown in TERPGRID and deleted after 90 days (read) or 30 days (removed). Operator messages (e.g. backup errors) are completely separate.

sp.conflictA: Someone else changed this entry at the same time
sp.transferMsg: {name} must accept the transfer. {name} then manages members and rights, and you become “Edit”. The space’s files then count towards the quota of {name}.
sp.keyGen: Separate space key, generation {n} – encrypted on the server (AES-256-GCM), separate from all account keys.
sp.storage: Storage of the space’s files: {size} (counts towards the owner’s quota).
sp.deleteWarn: All content, photos, comments and the history are deleted – including contributions of other members ({n} others). Members are notified. Exported copies stay with their owners. The space key is destroyed; encrypted remnants in backups are then no longer readable.

notSent.one: {count} of your changes was not transferred
notSent.other: {count} of your changes were not transferred

sp.revokedText: You are no longer a member of this space. Cached content has been removed from this browser.
sp.noAccessText: This space does not exist or you are not a member.
sp.notSentText: Your access ended before these changes were sent. They will no longer be transferred. You can save them as a file for yourself.
sp.noContentOwner: Create something directly here – or share specific private entries via “Share” on the page of a grow, strain, journal entry, collection item or lab report.
sp.noContentMember: As soon as members with edit rights add content, it appears here.
sp.removeMsg: Access ends immediately – also on all of this person’s devices; unsent changes are rejected. Copies already downloaded (e.g. exports) cannot be deleted remotely. The person’s content and comments remain in the space.
sp.leaveMsg: You immediately lose access to all content. Your contributions and comments remain in the space (they belong to the space). Export anything you want to keep first. You can only rejoin with a new invitation.
sp.inviteSub: Confirmed friends only. The invitation is valid for 14 days and can be revoked.
sp.historyNote: The history only shows who did what when – no content. Entries about content you may not see are hidden.
sp.name: Name
sp.exportHint: Owners and editors can always export. Screenshots or transcripts can never be prevented technically.
sp.exportText: ZIP with all content your role may see (including photos and documents). Exports are then stored unencrypted on your device and cannot be revoked remotely.
sp.exportDenied: The owner has not allowed export for your role.
sp.noE2ee: No end-to-end encryption: the server operator could technically decrypt.
sp.rightsChecked: Rights are checked on the server for every action.

sr.deleteMsg: “{title}” will be deleted for all members{incl}. Comments are hidden. Exported copies of other members stay with them.
sr.deleteIncl: – including related plants, entries and photos
sr.editorHint: Stored in the space with the space key – not in your private data.
sr.addEntryHint: Observation, measurement or care – visible to everyone allowed to see this grow.
sr.noAccessText: This entry is not (or no longer) visible to you.
sr.unavailableText: This entry was deleted or is not shared with your role.
sr.photoFail: Photo entry could not be saved (offline?).
sr.copyHint: Shared copy: independent of the private original – later private changes are not transferred.
sr.accessNote: Also applies to all related plants, entries, photos and comments.

ss.noAccess: No more access to this space.
ss.noAccess2: You no longer have access to this space.
